terminals.name: backend
terminals.description: control-plane :8080 + llm-gateway :8081 (mock upstream unless a provider key is set)

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: Web chat UI on :5173 (proxies /v1 and /health to :8080). Login admin / 123456.
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v$(cat .nvmrc)/bin:$PATH"; until curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8080/health >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done; pnpm --filter @neo-cloud-agent/web dev
